description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Chronomancy)

Benefit: As long as you have a chronomancy spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you gain the ability to alter the threads of fate, taking 1 point of Ability Burn to your casting ability score to reroll any d20, usable multiple times but never more than once per roll. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting chronomancy spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Chronomancy)
